chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about a man who had sexual intercourse with a woman, whether he may marry her mother from breastfeeding or her daughter? He said: No.
ai.seo_question: Can a man marry the mother or daughter of the woman he had sex with?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that fornication (*fujur*) creates a prohibition of marriage (*mahramiyyah*) with the woman's mother and daughter, extending the concept of kinship ties to include these direct female relatives. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between blood, breastfeeding, and marital ties, confirming that sexual union with a woman renders her immediate female ancestors and descendants permanently unlawful for marriage to that man.
